name: get_byte_statistics
title: Get Byte Statistics
description: Calculates byte-level statistics over a region of the currently selected data source: unique byte count, null byte ratio, printable character ratio, most common byte, entropy and optionally the full 256-entry byte frequency distribution. Good first step when analyzing an unknown binary.

size.description: Number of bytes to analyze. Defaults to the rest of the data source

include_distribution.description: Whether to include the full 256-entry byte frequency distribution

unique_bytes.description: Number of distinct byte values that occur in the region

most_common_byte.description: Byte value that occurs most often

entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the region in bits per byte

distribution.description: Occurrence count for each byte value 0x00 to 0xFF (only if include_distribution is true)
